_readme: All 400 word labels and 18 lesson titles follow the supplied VSL 400 PDF. Published lessons expose vocabulary; video availability is independent. Only pre-existing sample videos are retained; no source videos were imported. English word labels fall back to Vietnamese where a translation is not available.
